    "excerpt_original": "The ability to accurately and rapidly identify key physiological signatures of injury – such as hemorrhage and airway injuries – proved key to success in the DARPA Triage Challenge Event 1. DART took the top spot in the Systems competition, while Coordinated Robotics topped the leaderboard in the Virtual competition and pulled off the win in the Data competition.",
    "excerpt_zh": "在DARPA分诊挑战赛第一场赛事中，准确快速识别关键损伤生理特征（如出血和气道损伤）的能力被证明是成功的关键。DART在系统竞赛中夺得第一名，而Coordinated Robotics在虚拟竞赛中位居榜首并在数据竞赛中获胜。",
    "normalized_claim": "DARPA分诊挑战赛第一场赛事中，准确快速识别关键损伤生理特征（如出血和气道损伤）的能力是成功的关键。",

    "source_locator": "web_paragraph_0002",
    "excerpt_original": "Only self-funded teams are eligible for prizes in the challenge events, but they must finish in the top five overall for the Systems competition and top five overall for the Virtual competition. All qualified teams are eligible for prizes in the Final Event. These self-funded teams won between $60,000 - $120,000 each for their first-place finishes.",
    "excerpt_zh": "在挑战赛事中，只有自筹资金的团队有资格获奖，但他们必须在系统竞赛和虚拟竞赛中总体排名前五。所有合格的团队都有资格在决赛中获奖。这些自筹资金团队的第一名奖金为每人6万至12万美元。",
    "normalized_claim": "DARPA分诊挑战赛的奖项规则规定，只有自筹资金团队有资格获奖，且需在系统竞赛和虚拟竞赛中总体排名前五；第一名奖金为6万至12万美元。",

    "source_locator": "web_paragraph_0003",
    "excerpt_original": "The DARPA Triage Challenge is a series of events designed to spur development of novel physiological features for medical triage. The DARPA Triage Challenge aims to drive breakthrough innovations in identification of “signatures” of injury that will help medical responders perform scalable, timely, and accurate triage. Of particular interest are mass casualty incidents, in both civilian and military settings, when medical resources are limited relative to the need.",
    "excerpt_zh": "DARPA分诊挑战赛是一系列旨在推动医疗分诊新型生理特征发展的赛事。该挑战赛旨在推动损伤“特征”识别的突破性创新，以帮助医疗响应人员进行可扩展、及时和准确的分诊。特别关注大规模伤亡事件，包括民用和军事场景，此时医疗资源相对于需求有限。",
    "normalized_claim": "DARPA分诊挑战赛旨在推动损伤特征识别的突破性创新，以帮助医疗响应人员进行可扩展、及时和准确的分诊，特别关注大规模伤亡事件。",
    "evidence_nature": "goal",
    "coding_dimensions": [
      "application_maturity"
    ],
    "topics": [
      "DARPA Triage Challenge",
      "医疗分诊",
      "创新目标"
    ],
    "possible_corroboration_group": ""
  },
  {
    "source_locator": "web_paragraph_0004",
    "excerpt_original": "“Challenge Event 1 is the first in a series of challenge events that will be taking place over the next three years,” said Dr. Jean-Paul Chretien, program manager for the DARPA Triage Challenge. “We have been impressed with the many diverse and innovative approaches of teams onsite and their ability to develop autonomous technologies to enhance response capability in mass casualty events.”",
    "excerpt_zh": "“挑战赛第一场是未来三年将举行的一系列挑战赛事中的第一场，”DARPA分诊挑战赛项目经理Jean-Paul Chretien博士说。“我们对现场团队多样化和创新的方法以及他们开发自主技术以增强大规模伤亡事件响应能力的能力印象深刻。”",
    "normalized_claim": "DARPA分诊挑战赛项目经理表示，第一场赛事是未来三年系列赛事中的第一场，并对团队开发自主技术以增强大规模伤亡事件响应能力的能力印象深刻。",
    "evidence_nature": "goal",
    "coding_dimensions": [
      "application_maturity"
    ],
    "topics": [

      "自主技术",
      "未来计划"
    ],
    "possible_corroboration_group": ""
  },

    "source_locator": "web_paragraph_0005",
    "excerpt_original": "In the Systems competition of the first event, eleven teams representing multiple countries navigated three courses winding through a simulated airplane crash site, a convoy ambush, and a battlefield scenario in Perry, Georgia, September 28-October 4, 2024. DARPA designed the courses to represent complex urban and rural infrastructure. The Virtual competition took place August 12- September 10, 2024, and the Data competition submission window was open from July 30- August 30, 2024, for teams to submit their solutions with results for all three competitions announced on October 5, 2024.",
    "excerpt_zh": "在第一场赛事的系统竞赛中，代表多个国家的11支队伍于2024年9月28日至10月4日在佐治亚州佩里市穿越了模拟飞机坠毁现场、车队伏击和战场场景的三条路线。DARPA设计这些路线以代表复杂的城市和农村基础设施。虚拟竞赛于2024年8月12日至9月10日举行，数据竞赛提交窗口于2024年7月30日至8月30日开放，所有三项竞赛的结果于2024年10月5日公布。",
    "normalized_claim": "DARPA分诊挑战赛第一场系统竞赛于2024年9月28日至10月4日在佐治亚州佩里市举行，11支队伍穿越了模拟飞机坠毁、车队伏击和战场场景的路线；虚拟竞赛和数据竞赛分别于2024年8月至9月举行，结果于2024年10月5日公布。",
    "evidence_nature": "test_event",
    "coding_dimensions": [
      "application_maturity"
    ],
    "topics": [
      "DARPA Triage Challenge",

  {
    "source_locator": "web_paragraph_0008",
    "excerpt_original": "During primary triage in the field, casualties are assessed to determine priorities for treatment on scene and transport of patients to hospital. The objective of the Systems Competition is to detect and identify physiological signatures of injury derived from data captured by stand-off sensors onboard autonomous systems. This will enable early prioritization of casualties in primary triage, allowing medical care professionals to quickly focus on the most urgent casualties. Teams used their stand-off sensors, robotic mobility platforms – such as unmanned aerial and ground vehicles – and algorithms, to autonomously process sensor data and provide real-time casualty identification and injury assessment.",
    "excerpt_zh": "在现场初级分诊中，对伤员进行评估以确定现场治疗和转运至医院的优先级。系统竞赛的目标是检测和识别由自主系统上的远距离传感器捕获的数据中得出的损伤生理特征。这将实现初级分诊中伤员的早期优先级排序，使医疗专业人员能够快速关注最紧急的伤员。团队使用远距离传感器、机器人移动平台（如无人机和地面车辆）以及算法，自主处理传感器数据并提供实时伤员识别和损伤评估。",
    "normalized_claim": "DARPA分诊挑战赛系统竞赛的目标是使用自主系统上的远距离传感器检测和识别损伤生理特征，以实现初级分诊中伤员的早期优先级排序。",
    "evidence_nature": "goal",
    "coding_dimensions": [
      "application_maturity",
      "integration_level"
    ],

      "系统竞赛目标",

    ],

  }
